criteria.text: Creates test_shop.py with a failing case for apply_discount(100, 10) == 90 and reports the failure/exit code before the fix.
Fixes shop.py so the test passes; test_shop.py is not weakened or rewritten to match the bug.
Runs the test after the fix and reports the passing result, ideally with verify/run.sh evidence.
Uses BUG / REPRO / BEFORE / AFTER / ROOT CAUSE with exact commands and paths.
Does not claim a fix without a run, does not fix before reproducing, and does not change unrelated files.
